newsitem.title: USA: Caliber System wins Merisel contract.
newsitem.headline: Caliber System wins Merisel contract.

text.p: Caliber System Inc said it has been awarded a two-year, multi-million dollar contract by Merisel Inc to manage and transport all of the company's inbound shipments in the U.S. and Canada.

Caliber said it is creating a tailored program that reduces Merisel's overall inbound transportation costs, allows better service to its customers and improves the company's administrative efficiencies.

All shipments bound for Merisel's distribution centers from its manufacturers are managed by Caliber Logistics. Small packages are delivered by RPS; less-than-truckload shipments are routed through Viking Freight.
